items.title: How did activation change?
assumptions: The two supplied weeks use the same activation definition.

source.label: Illustrative activation export
source.sql: SELECT week, activated, eligible FROM sample_activation ORDER BY week;

metricDefinitions.label: Activation rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Activation rate is the share of eligible accounts that completed setup during the week.

caveats: Synthetic example; no external source was queried.

evidenceFlow.title: Recorded inputs
evidenceFlow.detail: The supplied sample contains weekly counts of eligible and activated accounts.
